name: notebook
description: elena's investigation notebook. filled with observations about the blackwood case.

params.success_message: you flip through the notebook. elena has documented the blackwood disappearance in detail — seven people vanished overnight in 1891, the front door barred from inside, no forced entry. the case file mentions a crystal skull found on the property, later moved to an unknown location within the mansion. sketches show a skull-shaped keyhole on the front door. notes suggest the family may have been involved in something occult. the final page is blank except for the words: 'find the skull.'
